question: Between who among the following did the Battle of Chandawar take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaychand and Muhammad Ghori.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Battle of Chandawar:-**

 
 
• It took place in 1194 AD.
 
• **The battle was fought between the Hindu king Jaychand and the Muslim invader Muhammad Ghori.**
 
• It was a significant battle in the history of India as it marked the end of the Chauhan dynasty and the beginning of the Muslim rule in Northern India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mahmood Gaznavi:-**

 
 
• He was a ruler from the 10th century and had no involvement in the Battle of Chandawar.
